steps.name: basics
steps.label: Basics
steps.description: Build a Windows golden image with the CrowdStrike Falcon sensor pre-installed. Provide your Falcon API Client ID/Secret. A Key Vault is created and seeded with the secrets by the deployment.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Region for the gallery, image, Key Vault, and Image Builder template.

elements.name: falconClientId
elements.label: CrowdStrike API Client ID
elements.toolTip: Falcon OAuth2 API client id. Needs Sensor Download (read) and Sensor Update Policies (read) scopes.

validations.message: Client ID is a 32-character hexadecimal string.

elements.name: falconClientSecret
elements.toolTip: Falcon OAuth2 API client secret. Stored as a secret in the Key Vault created by this deployment.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the API client secret (letters and numbers, 32+ characters).

options.text: The base Windows image the golden image is built from. It must be a Gen2 / Trusted Launch capable SKU. Defaults target Windows Server 2022 Datacenter (Gen2).

elements.name: sourceImagePublisher
elements.label: Publisher
elements.toolTip: Marketplace image publisher. Feeds the live SKU list below.

elements.name: sourceImageOffer
elements.label: Offer
elements.toolTip: Marketplace image offer. Feeds the live SKU list below.

elements.name: sourceImageSku
elements.label: SKU
elements.toolTip: Windows Server SKU (pulled live from Azure for the selected region). Only Gen2 / Trusted Launch capable SKUs are listed (the golden image is Gen2), e.g. 2022-datacenter-g2 or *-azure-edition.

constraints.allowedValues: [map(filter(steps('sourceImage').skusApi, (item) => or(contains(item.name, 'g2'), or(contains(item.name, 'gensecond'), contains(item.name, 'azure-edition')))), (item) => parse(concat('{"label":"', item.name, '","value":"', item.name, '"}')))]

elements.name: sourceImageVersion
elements.label: Version
elements.toolTip: Source image version. 'latest' uses the newest published version, or enter an exact version.

validations.message: Use 'latest' or an exact version like 20348.2402.240607.
